cohort: The study participants were younger women and older women from the same households in India, whose data were collected as part of the National Family Health Survey-5.
finding: The study found that the childbirth experiences of older women strongly affect younger women's decisions to opt for elective Caesarean sections, highlighting the important role of influence within households.
mod_finding: Younger women were significantly more likely to choose elective Caesarean sections if older women in the same household had previously undergone one.
